descriptions.Eyebrow: Small-caps monospace kicker label for section headings.
descriptions.StatusDot: Coloured presence dot; optional live ping animation.
descriptions.Avatar: Initials avatar tinted from a person colour; optional status dot.
descriptions.AvatarStack: Overlapping avatar row with a +N overflow bubble.
descriptions.Chip: Small uppercase pill badge; plain / accent / live tones.
descriptions.Panel: Titled card section with optional index, kicker, action slot, and accent glow.
descriptions.Counter: Animated number that tweens between values (rAF).
descriptions.Sparkline: Mini SVG trend line with soft area fill and end dot.
descriptions.Rule: Hairline divider, optionally with a centred small-caps label.
descriptions.Segmented: Sliding segmented tab switcher (CSS anchor-positioned pill).
descriptions.IconButton: Round 36px outlined icon button with hover/active states.
descriptions.Field: Labelled form-field wrapper (small-caps label above content).
